sources.locator: Page 1, package dimensions figure, recommended soldering pattern figure, selection guide table; page 2, absolute maximum ratings table and electrical characteristics table.
sources.evidence_extract: Exact APHHS1005QWF/D, 1.0 x 0.5 mm body, nominal 0.7 x 0.5 mm recommended pads with 0.2 mm gap. The recommended pattern figure explicitly states tolerance +/-0.1 mm. Pin 1 cathode, pin 2 anode. DC forward current absolute maximum 30 mA at 25 C.
